Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Declares a synchronous benchmark that executes inside PostgreSQL.
Native entry points are emitted only when AnkusIncludeBenchmarks is enabled.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
public sealed class PgBenchmarkAttribute : Attribute
```

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute)
